page.title: Telemetry: every step is a span
page.description: tinyactors reports what its actors do as OpenTelemetry: a span for each step, logs and metrics, with W3C trace context across actors and systems.

hero.headline: Every step is a span
hero.lede: A host reports what its actors did as OpenTelemetry: a span for each step, logs, and metrics. It does no I/O itself. Your exporter sends the bytes.

section.heading: Read a trace
section.p: This payment charges a card, retries after 30 seconds of silence, and gives up after three attempts.
Run it, traced, while the service is silent once and then answers. Each row is a step under the step that caused it, and selecting one shows its transitions and sends.

section.heading: Turn it on
section.p: Give the host an encoder in its config and a handler for the requests it writes. The handler gets OTLP bytes to post to a collector, and this one reads the spans back.

section.heading: Follow a request
section.p: A traceparent passed with an input is the parent of the step it starts. A send carries the sender's trace to the next actor, or to another system.

section.heading: Choose what is traced
section.p: Set the detail for every actor, or watch one chart closely for a while.
